pendingOutings.line: 喉咙发干，冰咖啡灌下去总算能清醒一点了。

items.imgPrompt: carved white nephrite jade hair crown with fox motifs, resting on dark red silk cloth on a wooden dresser, soft ambient room lighting

name.en: Cangwu Realm White Jade Fox Hair Crown

desc.zh: 本殿下從前戴的，純白靈玉雕成。現在用不著了……反正、反正那人親手給我束了紅發帶，比這冷冰冰的石頭好一萬倍！不許講價！
desc.zh_cn: 本殿下从前戴的，纯白灵玉雕成。现在用不着了……反正、反正那人亲手给我束了红发带，比这冷冰冰的石头好一万倍！不许讲价！
desc.en: Carved from pure spiritual jade, worn when I was still a prince. Don't need it anymore... she tied my hair with a red ribbon anyway, ten thousand times better than cold stone! No bargaining!

items.imgPrompt: dark ceramic clay stew pot with faint brown scorch marks around the base, sitting on a kitchen counter near a folded tea towel

name.zh: 微瑕黑陶燉盅（附贈金絲蜜棗）
name.zh_cn: 微瑕黑陶炖盅（附赠金丝蜜枣）
name.en: Glazed Clay Stew Pot (Includes Candied Dates)

desc.zh: 凡人的炊具真是麻煩透頂！火候根本算不準，手指還被燙到了……她居然還嫌湯太甜！氣死本殿下了。誰愛燉誰拿去，裡面洗乾淨了。
desc.zh_cn: 凡人的炊具真是麻烦透顶！火候根本算不准，手指还被烫到了……她居然还嫌汤太甜！气死本殿下了。谁爱炖谁拿去，里面洗干净了。
desc.en: Mortal cookware is terribly bothersome! The fire was impossible to control, burnt my fingers... and she still said the broth was too sweet! Taking it away, thoroughly cleaned.

items.imgPrompt: large unopened flat cardboard shipping box with cat tree illustrations, leaning upright against a pale interior wall on hardwood flooring

name.zh: 多層實木貓爬架（全新未拆）
name.zh_cn: 多层实木猫爬架（全新未拆）
name.en: Multilevel Wooden Cat Tree (Brand New Unopened)

desc.zh: 買錯了！絕對不拆！家裡有本殿下的九條銀尾巴還不夠你摸嗎？！為什麼要盯著路邊的野貓看？！限同城快點搬走，看著就煩！
desc.zh_cn: 买错了！绝对不拆！家里有本殿下的九条银尾巴还不够你摸吗？！为什么要盯着路边的野猫看？！限同城快点搬走，看着就烦！
desc.en: A huge mistake, unopened! Aren't my nine silver tails enough for petting?! Why look at some stray cat outside?! Pick it up locally, it irritates me just sitting here!

items.imgPrompt: antique circular bronze mirror with inlaid yellow jade center and engraved cloud reliefs, lying on a plain dark grey linen mat

name.en: Fox Clan Warm Jade Protection Mirror

desc.zh: 能擋下凡間凶煞之氣。但本殿下每晚都親自守在她榻邊布防，根本用不上這種破銅爛鐵。賣了換錢去買東街鋪子的糖霜栗子吃……
desc.zh_cn: 能挡下凡间凶煞之气。但本殿下每晚都亲自守在她榻边布防，根本用不上这种破铜烂铁。卖了换钱去买东街铺子的糖霜栗子吃……
desc.en: Wards off hostile spirits. But with me guarding her bedside every single night, this metal scrap is useless. Selling it to buy sugar-frosted chestnuts downtown...

items.imgPrompt: carved bone folding fan inlaid with brass filigree and a black silk tassel, semi-unfolded on a plain wooden low table

name.zh: 金絲鏤雕獸骨折扇（隨便賣）
name.zh_cn: 金丝镂雕兽骨折扇（随便卖）
name.en: Carved Bone Folding Fan with Gold Inlay

desc.zh: 不知道哪個不知死活的外邦使臣硬塞給她的，俗氣死了！反正我已經偷偷收起來了，她肯定記不得……便宜甩了，別讓我再看到！
desc.zh_cn: 不知道哪个不知死活的外邦使臣硬塞给她的，俗气死了！反正我已经偷偷收起来了，她肯定记不得……便宜甩了，别让我再看到！
desc.en: Some insolent envoy shoved this onto her, utterly gaudy! I hid it away quietly anyway, she won't notice... Selling dirt cheap, don't want to see it ever again!
